# Component references

The booking calendar in `src/advanced-ui.jsx` adapts the calendar/time-slot layout from [Calendar Scheduler by Ruixen UI](https://21st.dev/@ruixen.ui/components/calendar-scheduler). It uses React Day Picker with Thai locale and the app's availability rules.

[Daily Timeline Scheduler by Ruixen UI](https://21st.dev/@ruixen.ui/components/daily-timeline-scheduler) was used in the first version. The current room/day grid in `src/advanced-pages.jsx` is a separate implementation.

Original source references were obtained through the author's signed-in 21st.dev account. They are kept locally and excluded from Git. No redistribution license for those original files is asserted here.
